Description: Bought recently, buy often and spend the most.
Recommended_action: Reward them: VIP/loyalty perks, early access to new products, ask for reviews and referrals.

Description: Regular buyers with above-average spend who are still active.
Recommended_action: Upsell higher-value products, cross-sell bundles, invite into the loyalty program.

Description: Used to buy often and spend well, but haven't purchased in a while.
Recommended_action: Win-back campaign now: personalised emails, limited-time offer, ask what changed.

Description: Bought recently but only a few times and with modest spend so far.
Recommended_action: Onboarding journey, second-purchase incentive, product recommendations to build the habit.

Description: Last purchase long ago, few orders, low spend.
Recommended_action: Low-cost automated reactivation only; exclude from expensive campaigns if they don't respond.
